rules.topic: Every Thermal machine and dynamo is driven by a recipe manager with a base power in RF per tick: the shared default is 20 RF/t, clamped to 1..32000 RF/t when configured; individual managers override it (magmatic crucible 80 RF/t, crystallizer and pyrolyzer 5 RF/t). Augments and server config scale from this base

All single-item and single-fluid fuel dynamos generate at a base of 40 RF/t before augments: stirling (solid fuel), magmatic (hot fluids), compression (fluid fuels), numismatic, lapidary, disenchantment and gourmand dynamos all start from 40 RF/t

Fuel reference energies normalize how long a fuel burns at base power: magmatic and compression fuels reference 100000 RF per fuel unit (fluid fuels are defined per 1000 mB in recipe data); stirling, lapidary, numismatic and disenchantment fuels reference 16000 RF per item; actual per-fuel values are recipe data in the jar
Gourmand dynamo fuel value is formulaic: energy = food nutrition x 1600 RF (DEFAULT_ENERGY 1600 at line 32), so a 10-nutrition food yields 16000 RF; saturation is not part of the formula

Machine recipes carry their own energy costs as data; managers only supply defaults for unlisted recipes (pulverizer default 4000 RF per recipe). Quote per-recipe costs from the jar's recipe data (layer 1/2), not from manager constants
